input.body:
Address: Flat 3, 171 Willowmere Road, Alderwick, ZZ6 0ZZ

Hi,

The tenant of this property has reported the following. Can you please advise if you wish for me to instruct a contractor to attend or if you want to arrange your own contractor?

Request description: "Bedroom window not shutting, handle not engaging."

Further detail from the tenant: one bedroom window is affected; the handle turns but does not click in, and the window is unable to close properly. No pets and no special access arrangements.

As the window cannot currently be closed and locked, we are treating this as urgent (target: contractor within 3 working days). If we find the window is accessible from outside and the flat cannot be secured, we will arrange an emergency make-safe under our emergency authority and let you know the same day. If you'd like us to instruct our panel contractor, the likely work is a handle/locking mechanism repair or replacement, which we would expect to fall within the standard £250 pre-authorised limit; we will come back to you for approval if a quote exceeds that.

Ref: TKT-6E1FE6

Hello,

Thank you for reporting that your bedroom window is not shutting and the handle is not engaging (ref TKT-6E1FE6). We have logged this as an urgent repair and have contacted your landlord to arrange a contractor. We will let you know who is coming and when as soon as this is confirmed.

So we can judge how quickly this needs attending, please reply to tell us:
1. Which floor the flat/bedroom is on, and whether the window could be reached from outside (e.g. ground floor, next to a flat roof, balcony or fire escape).
2. Whether you can currently pull the window shut so the flat is secure, even if the handle won't lock.

In the meantime: please keep the window pulled to as far as possible, especially at night or when you are out, and avoid forcing the handle as this can damage the mechanism further. If the window swings open on its own, is at risk of falling, or you feel the flat cannot be secured, please call us straight away and we will arrange an emergency attendance.

Kind regards,
Maintenance team
